hierarchy.meaning: DIO is the shared governed intelligence organism.
META primitives are reusable trust machinery: Evidence, Assurance, Authority and Room.
Work patterns are reusable operational grammar for recurring shapes of expensive human work.
Profiles are declarative configuration that changes sector, framework, authority, connector, output and commercial semantics without changing the organism.
Incarnations are named customer-facing or internal outcome products generated by composition.

canonical_definitions.product: A governed composition specification expressed by a DIO Product Manifest. A product is not an organ, executor, suite, repository or proof of maturity.
canonical_definitions.profile: A declarative, independently versionable configuration object belonging to one canonical profile class. A profile configures semantics or policy and does not create authority or execution capability.
canonical_definitions.organ: A reusable internal DIO capability-bearing subsystem that implements governed functions behind stable contracts. An organ is not a customer-facing product by itself.
canonical_definitions.executor: A runtime-capable implementation selected to fulfil an execution requirement under existing DIO authority boundaries. The compiler may resolve an executor; a manifest may not create one.
canonical_definitions.suite: A market-facing packaging and navigation umbrella that groups incarnations. Suite membership has no runtime, authority, maturity or execution semantics.
canonical_definitions.incarnation: A named outcome product for a buyer/work context represented by a product manifest. New incarnations normally reuse the organism, META, work patterns and profiles rather than introduce sovereign runtimes.
canonical_definitions.work_pattern: A domain-independent contract describing a recurring transformation shape, human decision boundary and automation risk.
canonical_definitions.meta_capability: One of the four reusable trust primitives: Evidence, Assurance, Authority or Room.

phase_boundaries.phase_0: Freeze vocabulary, contracts, registries, maturity semantics and repository ownership.
phase_boundaries.phase_1: Implement independently validating source/version/hash-bound profile schemas and concrete profile instances.
phase_boundaries.phase_2: Implement product validate/compile/inspect commands and resolver-generated runtime plans.
